functionalArchitectureSummary.compartments: Single freezer cabinet only — no fresh-food compartment, no multi-door routing, no through-door dispense
functionalArchitectureSummary.refrigeration: Fixed-speed compressor (EZ90H1A), evaporator fan, defrost heater, B3839 NTC thermistors (cabinet, defrost, ambient)
functionalArchitectureSummary.control: Main board + display communication (E6); E-family fault codes E2/E5/E6/E7/E9
functionalArchitectureSummary.defrost: Freezer defrost heater ~41 Ω (115 V 320 W); defrost sensor E5; forced defrost via test mode
functionalArchitectureSummary.optionalFeaturesAbsent: No ice maker, no water dispenser, no air damper fresh-food routing, no RC compartment sensors
functionalArchitectureSummary.supplementaryCorroboration: Midea RSS26 refrigerator manual shares E2/E5/E6/E7/E9 freezer-scoped diagnostic pattern — demonstrates french_door_refrigerator already models freezer compartment instances

procedureClassifications.provenance: Freezer cabinet NTC (B3839) — maps to conditionalConcept temperature_sensor with freezer compartment overlay binding.
procedureClassifications.frozenContractFit: french_door_refrigerator.temperature_sensor[freezer] — overlay binding, not new canonical node

procedureClassifications.provenance: Defrost termination sensing — platform defrost_sensor vocabulary on defrost_operation path.
Ambient NTC for control compensation — same role as refrigerator ambient sensing on Midea E-family.
Defrost heater actuation ~41 Ω — maps to defrost_heater canonical actuator with freezer instance scope.
Display↔main CN9 communication fault — maps to control_board + user_interface canonical nodes.
High-temperature alarm orchestrates fan/defrost/compressor checks — control-board monitoring of refrigeration_operation, not a new canonical domain.
Freezer evaporator fan commanded during cooling and E9 recovery — maps to evaporator_fan[freezer] instance.

refrigeratorSpecificDomainsAbsent.air_damper: Not present — not required; french_door_refrigerator.air_damper is conditional in airflow_operation
refrigeratorSpecificDomainsAbsent.ice_maker: Not present — optional conditionalConcept; not instantiated
refrigeratorSpecificDomainsAbsent.water_dispenser: Not present — optional conditionalConcept; not instantiated
refrigeratorSpecificDomainsAbsent.fresh_food_temperature_sensors: Not present — by product design, not diagnostic gap
